regulatory_or_exposure: Fractional iron absorption 49.3 ± 21.3% raw (n = 15) versus 33.9 ± 16.2% cooked (n = 14), p = 0.035 (Abstract)
Total iron absorbed 0.77 ± 0.33 mg raw versus 0.86 ± 0.41 mg cooked, p = 0.525 (Abstract; Results p. 4)
Iron intake 1.6 mg from 480 g raw and 2.6 mg from 500 g cooked banana per day (Results p. 4)
non_numeric_findings: Banana matrix judged not to impair iron absorption; proposed as a biofortification target.
Phytate to iron molar ratios (0.05 and 0.03) were far below the ratio known to impair absorption, per the authors.
